# utils.gt

<!-- badges: start -->
[![Lifecycle: experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)](https://lifecycle.r-lib.org/articles/stages.html#experimental)
[![CRAN status](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/utils.gt)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=utils.gt)
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of utils.gt is to enable consistent styling for 'gt' tables, including formatting, spanners, and summary rows. These wrapper functions are designed to be lightweight and easy to extend.

## Installation

You can install the development version of utils.gt from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("morethangray/utils.gt")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r
library(utils.gt)
## basic example code
```
